summary: Verified new notify_email + send-reset-link + forgot-password routing features (iteration 129). All 10 backend pytest cases pass; frontend NotifyEmailCard renders correctly in tenant Settings (with warning + save flow) and in Super Admin → Security tab (dark variant, above SecurityCard).
critical_code_review_comments: email_service._resolve_recipients elegantly de-dupes recipients and falls back through users.notify_email → staff.personal_email → tenant → HQ aliases. Good separation.
PUT /api/auth/me/notify-email validates '@' + TLD presence & rejects login-only domains — solid.
send-reset-link is properly rate-limited (5/hour per IP), requires auth (401 for unauth), and returns masked recipients.
Minor: send-reset-link masking assumes >=2 chars before '@' which is safe for the current test set but might expose too little on short addresses (e.g. 'a@x.com' → 'a•••@x.com'). Non-blocking.
NotifyEmailCard: no client-side email validation (backend catches it, toast shows detail). Acceptable.
test_credentials: Used credentials from /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin@miracurl.com / super@miracurl.com. Owner PIN 4321.
seed_data_creation: None. Cleaned up notify_email back to empty after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_notify_email.py. Rate limit on POST /api/auth/me/send-reset-link is 5/hour per IP; tests only invoke it 2-3× per run. Force-password-change screen was NOT UI-tested (would require flipping must_change_password on a test user — skipped per request). All feature elements have data-testid: notify-email-card, notify-email-warning, notify-email-input, notify-email-save, notify-email-current, super-tab-security, super-nav-more.
